body.name: Exhaustive finite negative-chord certificate
body.construction: If \(\widehat\gamma_{pq}+w_n\ge0\), return \(\mathcal C_{pq,n}=\bot\). Otherwise enumerate rational triples \((u_0,z,t_{\mathrm{ch}})\) by increasing height subject to \(u_0,u_0+t_{\mathrm{ch}}z\in\operatorname{int}(\Omega)\). For each triple, subdivide its chord into rational segments; use \(\mathcal O_n\) on \(\widehat H_p,\widehat H_q\) and enlarge its intervals entrywise by \(r_{H,n}\), forming outward-rounded interval vectors for the two Hessian integrals. Refine until the interval for their Euclidean inner product has rational upper endpoint below zero, and return that triple, the two increment intervals, and the negative upper endpoint. The strict trigger makes this search finite; on \(\mathcal B_n\), clipping is inactive and the enlarged intervals also enclose the population increments.
